gloss: eyesore; unpleasant to look at; obstructing one's view

definitions.gloss: eyesore; something unpleasant to look at; offensive to the eyes
definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone whose appearance is annoying, ugly, or unwelcome in one's field of vision.

definitions.gloss: obstructing one's view; in the way of one's sight
definitions.explanation: Something that physically blocks or interferes with what one is trying to see.

examples.japanese: あの{看板|かんばん}は{目障|めざわ}りだ。
{散|ち}らかった{部屋|へや}が{目障|めざわ}りで{集中|しゅうちゅう}できない。
examples.english: The messy room is distracting and I can't concentrate.

examples.japanese: {景色|けしき}がきれいなのに、{目障|めざわ}りな{電柱|でんちゅう}が{立|た}っている。
examples.english: The scenery is beautiful, but there's an unsightly utility pole standing in the way.

examples.japanese: テレビの{前|まえ}に{立|た}たないで。{目障|めざわ}りだから。
examples.english: Don't stand in front of the TV. You're in the way.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{上司|じょうし}にとって{目障|めざわ}りな{存在|そんざい}だった。
examples.english: She was an unwelcome presence as far as her boss was concerned.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}の{外|そと}に{建|た}てられた{高|たか}いビルが{目障|めざわ}りで、{以前|いぜん}の{眺|なが}めが{台無|だいな}しになった。
examples.english: The tall building that was erected outside the window is an eyesore and has ruined the view we used to have.

notes:
Composed of {目|め} (eye) + {障|さわ}り (hindrance, obstruction). Functions as both a noun and a な-adjective ({目障|めざわ}りな). When used about a person, it is quite rude and implies that their very presence is unwelcome.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目障|めざわ}りな{存在|そんざい}: an unwelcome presence
- {目障|めざわ}りな{広告|こうこく}: an annoying advertisement
- {目障|めざわ}りだ: it's an eyesore; it's in the way

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {耳障|みみざわ}り: unpleasant to the ear; grating — the auditory counterpart
- {邪魔|じゃま}: in the way; a nuisance — more general, not limited to visual annoyance
- {見苦|みぐる}しい: unsightly; disgraceful — focuses on the ugliness or indecency of appearance
